summary: The retry does what was asked, and I recommend passing it. The status-rendering functions moved unchanged into crates/athena-cli/src/display/status_view.rs, and display.rs re-exports `status` and `snapshot_status`, so no caller changes. display.rs now has 1462 lines before its test module, under the 1500-line limit. The last attempt failed because an athena-core test reads display.rs's source text to check that every status label is printed. That test now also reads the new file; its label list and assertions are unchanged, which fixes the cause rather than the symptom. I ran that test and the 22 athena-cli display tests myself, and all pass. fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in the recorded CI run (the root manifest is a virtual workspace, so that run covered every crate). The CHANGELOG has an Unreleased/Changed entry for the split, and only the expected files changed. The one finding is a nit: lib.rs was on the deliverables list but did not need to change.
